blocks.md: **Planner assumes column independence. city='NYC' AND zip='10001' → estimates selectivity as product. But they're correlated! Extended statistics (CREATE STATISTICS) teaches planner the truth.**

blocks.md: **Plan rows: 5 → 480 (actual 500).** Planner now knows city/zip correlation. Chooses Index Scan over Seq Scan. Extended stats are free (just ANALYZE) and transform plans for correlated columns.

blocks.md: **Expression must be IMMUTABLE.** No NOW(), random(), volatile functions. Expression index stores computed value — if function isn't immutable, index becomes inconsistent.

items.explain: Expression index only matches queries using the exact same expression.

items.q: Why must expression index functions be IMMUTABLE?
options: Index consistency — same input must always give same output
items.explain: If function returns different values for same input, index entries become wrong.

blocks.md: Planner uses: histogram (most common values), n_distinct, null_frac, correlation. For range: histogram bounds + linear interpolation. For equality: MCV list + 1/n_distinct for non-MCV. For correlated columns: independence assumption (wrong) unless extended stats exist.

blocks.title: Bitmap Index Scan — Multiple Indexes Combined

blocks.md: **Bitmap Index Scan:** Combines multiple indexes in memory (bitmap), then single heap fetch. Great for AND/OR combinations where no composite index exists. Recheck Cond means heap tuple rechecked (lossy pages).

items.q: Bitmap Index Scan is chosen when:
options: Multiple indexes can be combined for AND/OR
items.explain: BitmapAnd/BitmapOr combines multiple index scans in memory before heap access.

items.q: "Recheck Cond" in Bitmap Heap Scan means:
options: Heap tuple rechecked due to lossy bitmap pages
items.explain: Lossy bitmap pages store page-level, not tuple-level. Must recheck each tuple.

blocks.sql: CREATE STATISTICS s (DEPENDENCIES) ON city, zip FROM users;

revisionCard: Extended stats: DEPENDENCIES (correlation), NDISTINCT (group count), MCV (value combos)
CREATE STATISTICS + ANALYZE teaches planner truth about correlated columns
Expression index: exact expression match required; functions must be IMMUTABLE
Bitmap Index Scan: combines multiple indexes in memory; Recheck Cond = lossy pages
Planner assumes independence; extended stats fix correlation blindness
Statistics target: ALTER TABLE ... SET STATISTICS N — more histogram buckets

glossary.def: CREATE STATISTICS object capturing cross-column correlation (DEPENDENCIES, NDISTINCT, MCV).
Column A determines column B (e.g., zip_code → city). Planner learns via DEPENDENCIES stats.
Estimated distinct value count for GROUP BY accuracy. Extended stats improve this.
List of frequent value combinations for multi-column selectivity estimates.
Bitmap page stores page-level not tuple-level; requires Recheck Cond on heap.
Same input → same output, forever. Required for expression indexes.
